abstract: Computes interior-only Top‑K lists by smallest slack and by a KKT‑proxy (least-squares multipliers clipped to ≥0) at tol∈{1e−9,1e−8}, K∈{15,25,40,60}. Reports Jaccards (slack vs KKT) per K and tol, writes JSON+freeze under storage/noesis/nmap/{results,freezes}, and returns the baseline packing with a 1e−9 shrink.
